vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: brw-cold-outreach-sequence
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle contains metadata and a detailed markdown document (`SKILL.md`) providing instructions and examples for building personalized cold outreach sequences. The content is purely instructional and descriptive, guiding the AI agent (and implicitly the user) on how to generate effective outreach messages. There are no executable commands, no attempts at prompt injection to subvert the agent's behavior, no instructions for data exfiltration, persistence, or any other malicious activities. The external link is a legitimate attribution and call to action for the skill's author, not an instruction for the agent to interact with it in a harmful way.
